name: omnicode-telegram
description: Drive Omnicode from Telegram: pick a session, send prompts, switch model, profile, thinking level and permission mode, and follow the reply.

interface.shortDescription: Select and drive a Omnicode session from a Telegram chat
interface.longDescription: Omnicode Telegram runs a small local bot that talks to your own Omnicode server over loopback. From a Telegram chat you can list sessions, pick one, send prompts, and change the model, profile, thinking level, permission mode and plan mode for the next prompt. Only chat ids you explicitly allow can send commands; the bot refuses to serve anyone else.
